code='''def transform(grid):
    h,w=len(grid),len(grid[0]); out=[r[:] for r in grid]
    start=next(( (i,j) for i in range(h) for j in range(w) if grid[i][j]==2))
    seen=set([start]); q=[start]
    while q:
        i,j=q.pop()
        for di,dj in ((1,0),(-1,0),(0,1),(0,-1)):
            a,b=i+di,j+dj
            while 0<=a<h and 0<=b<w and grid[a][b]!=8:
                if grid[a][b]==0: out[a][b]=2
                if (a,b) not in seen: seen.add((a,b)); q.append((a,b))
                a+=di;b+=dj
    return out
'''
